description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: five tiers (red lines, today, in progress, common sense, archive) with tiered prompt injection, BM25 recall with a 120-day decay floor, automatic capture of user messages, and timed consolidation. Zero dependencies; memory is plain Markdown and JSONL under $DSH_HOME. It records conversation locally in plain text and makes no network requests. GitHub install only — not published to npm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆：红线 / 当天 / 进行中 / 常识 / 档案五层，分层注入提示词，BM25 召回带 120 天半衰期衰减，自动记录用户消息并定时归纳。零依赖，记忆以纯 Markdown 和 JSONL 存在 $DSH_HOME 下，只记录到本机明文文件，不发起任何网络请求。仅支持 GitHub 安装，未发布到 npm。
